decisions: Package A needed no new file: split §3.0, §3, §4 and §4.1 are the canonical registries (split §0 marks them normative); A's gate was checked mechanically and recorded in test.json.
The blueprint's invariants[] and openQuestions[] are parsed from split §4/§4.1, not retyped, so they cannot drift.
I28 is classed review, matching split §4's totals (review 2) and g12's list of 15 tree checks; the table cell reads 'script + review'.
page-stage has hasPainter: false — no source requires a painter for the Stage host; adding one later needs a blueprint edit first, which is I25's point.

I13 applies once localFirst.db exists and I25 once a leaf's folder exists; otherwise task 004's 'verify green on the real tree' gate could never pass before 006/009/011/015 build them. An empty src/ passes, a missing src/ fails; the fixture suite, not an empty tree, is the anti-stub gate.
I25 treats 'conditional' leaves as skipped and 'not-needed' leaves as must-not-have-a-painter; the blueprint status enum is active | conditional | not-needed.
I16 skips whitelist entries that are I12 violations (entities, a reducerPath) so one mistake fails one id.
blueprint.schema.json has no maxItems on invariants/openQuestions: the escalation procedure adds rows; the counts are asserted by tests instead.
eslint.architecture.mjs uses a local plugin with one rule per invariant: core no-restricted-imports is a single rule, so overlapping file globs would silently overwrite each other.
Fixture trees and lint fixtures never touch the project tree (os.tmpdir() / lintText), so 000 needed no change to tsconfig.json or eslint.config.mjs.
Source text is CRLF-normalised on read: git autocrlf gives Windows checkouts CRLF.
The cold-agent gate for package C was self-graded (the owner did not answer whether a fresh agent may be spawned); recorded as a limitation.
